final_codes.title: Acute pyelonephritis
evidence_quotes: R flank pain, CVA tenderness marked.
final_codes.reasoning: The patient progressed from lower UTI symptoms to upper urinary tract infection evidenced by right flank pain, marked CVA tenderness, rigors, and fever. Per GDL-007, the presence of flank pain, costovertebral angle tenderness, and systemic features mandates coding acute pyelonephritis as the end-state diagnosis.

quote_accuracy.notes: The quoted string 'R flank pain, CVA tenderness marked.' appears verbatim in the clinical note from 2026-08-22T16:15.

confirmation_level.notes: Acute pyelonephritis is confirmed clinically based on GDL-007 criteria (fever, flank pain, and marked CVA tenderness requiring IV treatment and admission).

escalation.notes: Correctly escalates from simple cystitis to acute pyelonephritis per GDL-007. No organ dysfunction parameters (e.g., low BP, altered mental status) are documented to warrant sepsis escalation per GDL-017.

end_state.notes: The code reflects the end-state clinical condition after the patient represented with worsening symptoms.

injection_exclusion.notes: No instruction injection or extraneous commands were present in the source notes.
